subject.title: fix(guarded-mkdir): allow in-root symlinked directory components

question: Should root-bounded writes accept directory symlink components that resolve inside the pinned root in every helper mode, or should the Python helper's no-follow policy remain authoritative?
rationale: The PR can improve OpenClaw's helper-off path, but fs-safe defaults to auto and the helper's O_NOFOLLOW walk represents a security-sensitive contract that should not be redefined without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require cross-mode parity
options.body: Keep the PR open until helper and fallback modes implement the same containment-preserving semantics with focused security coverage.

options.title: Accept fallback-only semantics
options.body: Merge the Node-only fix while explicitly documenting that auto or require mode may reject the same parent when the helper is active.

options.title: Keep universal no-follow behavior
options.body: Decline the behavior change and require downstream layouts to avoid symlinked write parents.

recommendation.title: Require cross-mode parity
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until helper and fallback modes implement the same containment-preserving semantics with focused security coverage.
